selection: NLL chooses candidates only; source-grounded generated outputs decide professional acceptance. Iteration after an unsuccessful candidate requires a new recorded diagnosis and experiment version.

acceptance.source_method_review: Every evaluated generated response must satisfy task-specific role conditions, source evidence/contradictions/unknowns, timing alternatives and chronology. Semantic review is separate from protocol success and cannot be auto-filled from loss.
acceptance.unseen_chapter_coverage: No validation family means seen diagnostic only, never claim unseen chapter generalization.
acceptance.reported_feedback_accuracy: Score author prediction versus later reported outcome separately; don't relabel original failures as correct.
